name: pyannoteAI
tagline: Speaker intelligence — diarization that tells who spoke when.
description: pyannoteAI turns conversational audio into speaker-attributed transcripts: it identifies speakers, separates overlapping voices, and provides speaker metadata. Built on the widely used open-source pyannote.audio library, it adds a premium REST API and Python SDK with higher accuracy and near real-time speed.
insight: Its open-source pyannote.audio library sees 45M+ monthly downloads; the Paris company raised an €8.1M seed in April 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Ships its own speaker-diarization models; not an LLM app.

edge: Best-in-class speaker diarization — its premium model beats open-source baselines by ~20% while running roughly 2x faster.
cons: Top accuracy needs the paid API
